items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Big Chief Moore, and all them people. I said man, forget it. You know. Don't call me anymore.

ctx.x: I told him to bite me all over. I told him -- I don't know what the hell I didn't tell him, you know what I mean. I said you note playing son of a bitch, I called -- you know. You dirty (unintelligible). I just told you my name. You know -- everybody knows Fats Waller. I said now you can go buy you a record, and play it, drop a nickle in the juke box, I don't care what you do. You know, they -- good-bye! And I walked the hell out. So afterwards

I was working with -- some place, and two, three guys came in while I was playing, and he said well we -- Lester Lanin's lieutenants. I cursed him out. No, wait a minute, said we could use you. I said naw, you couldn't use me. So I said Lester forget it. (Unintelligible).
